positive.source:
formal-claim EligibleClaim:
  profile fol-core/1-candidate
  sort Order
  predicate Eligible(Order)
  proposition forall order: Order: Eligible(order)
  ceiling "Eligibility only."
rule EligibleOrder:
  claim EligibleClaim

policy Fulfillment:
  inputs order
  case EligibleOrder -> SubmitOrder
  default RejectOrder
  applies SubmitOrder, RejectOrder

state-machine OrderLifecycle:
  subject Order
  initial Draft
  state Draft
  state Submitted
  transition Submit:
    from Draft
    to Submitted
    on OrderPlaced
    guard EligibleOrder

formal-claim ZeroTotal:
  profile fol-core/1-candidate
  sort Order
  sort Amount
  function Total(Order) -> Amount
  constant Zero: Amount
  proposition exists order: Order: Total(order) = Zero
  ceiling "One zero-total order."

negative.source:
formal-claim C:
  profile fol-core/1-candidate
  sort Order
  predicate P(Order)
  proposition forall o: Order: P(o)
  proposition exists o: Order: P(o)
  ceiling "test"

rule R:
  claim EligibleClaim
  predicate total > 0

policy P:
  case order.total > 0 -> SubmitOrder
  default RejectOrder

invariant I:
  claim EligibleClaim
  rule EligibleOrder
